 Japan v Brazil LIVE: Carlo Ancelotti and Raphinha sent off after last-gasp winner
 Japan 3-2 Brazil: Tatsuhiro Sakamoto scored a dramatic winner after Vinicius Jr had scored twice to help the Selecao fight from two goals down 
 Jamie Braidwood Saturday 14 November 2026 12:24 GMT

 Brazil coach Carlo Ancelotti was sent off at the end of the defeat to Japan ( Reuters ) Tatsuhiro Sakamoto’s last-gasp goal secured a famous win for Japan and Brazil , as head coach Carlo Ancelotti and captain Raphinha were both sent off protesting against their defeat in Singapore. 
 Coventry City’s Sakamoto, brought on as substitute, lifted a finish over the goalkeeper Pedro Morisco in the 90th minute after Brazil had fought from two goals down following a stunning Vinicius Jr double. 
 Brazil complained there had been a foul from Takumi Minamino in the build-up, and their protests to the Singapore referee led to dismissals for Ancelotti and Raphinha, who had that point had been taken off. 
 Brazil were furious at Japan’s opener, too, when goals from Takefusa Kubo and Keito Nakamura gave Japan a two-goal lead inside 20 minutes, with the Selecao’s high line looking suspect and their defence all at sea. 
 But Brazil’s response before half-time was impressive and Vinicius unleashed a rocket of a shot to beat goalkeeper Zion Suzuki, as Japan faced constant pressure before half-time. 
 Japan looked to have been denied a famous win when Vinicius curled a stunning strike beyond the dive of Suzuki, who could only push the effort onto the post and watch as it deflected in off the other post to cross the line. 
 But Sakamoto’s dramatic winner meant Japan earned revenge in what was a rematch of the summer’s World Cup last-32 clash, where Brazil broke their hearts with Gabriel Martinelli’s late goal in Houston. 
 Follow all the build-up and action to this friendly below: 
 Japan v Brazil
 Japan claim famous win over Brazil to earn revenge for World Cup defeat 
 90' GOAL! Tatsuhiro Sakamoto stuns Brazil with last-gasp winner [JPN 3-2 BRA] 
 75' GOAL! Vinicius Jr equalises with whipped shot off the post [JPN 2-2 BRA] 
 35' GOAL! Vinicius Jr gives Brazil hope with rocket into top corner [JPN 2-1 BRA] 
 19' GOAL! Nakamura left alone to thump Japan into two-goal lead [JPN 2-0 BRA] 
 15' GOAL! Kubo dribbles from halfway before finding finish [JPN 1-0 BRA] 
 Carlo Ancelotti and Raphinha sent off for protesting Japan's winner 
 Japan's second win against Brazil 
 Mixed emotions at full-time! Delight for Japan, who have beaten Brazil for just the second time in their history, earning some revenge for the summer’s World Cup defeat. Anger, though, for Brazil, who never like to lose and believe there was a foul in the build-up to Tatsuhiro Sakamoto’s late winner. 
 ( Reuters ) ( Reuters ) Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 12:22 FULL TIME! Japan 3-2 Brazil 
 That’s it! A famous win for Japan after Brazil had fought back from two goals down! 
 Brazil surround the referee at the full-time whistle! 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 12:14 GOAL! Japan 3-2 Brazil (SAKAMOTO 90')
 UNBELIEVABLE BRAZIL ARE STUNNED AT THE DEATH! 
 Brazil are furious! Bruno Guimaraes leads the appeals and Carlo Ancelotti complains as well. Ancelotti is sent off for his protest, and so is Raphinha! This is crazy! 
 Brazil were angered by a challenge from Minamino in midfield the build-up. But they failed to react and Japan piled forward. The ball broke to substitute Sakamoto in the box and he lifted a gorgeous finish over the goalkeeper. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 12:08 Japan 2-2 Brazil
 88 mins: Aston Villa’s Joao Gomes gets a sight of goal after driving forward but drags his shot wide. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 12:06 Japan 2-2 Brazil
 86 mins: More changes from Japan - defender Ayumu Seko is the only outfield player who remains from the starting XI. Vinicius and Endrick are booked after complaining to the referee for a foul on Vinicius. 
 ( Getty ) Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 12:05 Japan 2-2 Brazil 
 84 mins: SAVE! A ferocious strike from Endrick from distance! But Suzuki manages to tip it over! 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:57 GOAL! Japan 2-2 Brazil (VINICIUS 75') 
 ANOTHER STUNNER FROM THE MAIN MAN! 
 Brilliant from Vinicius! From the short corner, he whips a stunning shot towards the far corner! Suzuki gets a touch onto it, but only enough to direct it onto the post. It richoches across the line, off the other post, and crosses! 
 Brazil have fought from two goals down! Can they get a winner now? 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:52 Japan 2-1 Brazil
 72 mins: Alisson Santana has been bright since coming on. He shapes to cut inside onto his left foot and get into the box but Hiroki Ito reads the danger well and wins his challenge. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:51 Japan 2-1 Brazil
 69 mins: Ancelotti sends on Endrick and withdraws Raphinha. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:48 Japan 2-1 Brazil
 68 mins: Dangerous from Vinicius! He whips in a dangerous cross from the left with the outside of his right foot but there’s no one in the middle to meet it. Alisson then shows quick feet to burst down the right, but Japan recover well to only concede the corner. From Raphinha’s cross, Gabriel’s flicked header fails to find the target.
